summary: First full run of backend and frontend tests for the Predator Autolight system. Backend: 25 pytest tests, 23 passed. Auth playbook checks also run with curl and all passed: bcrypt $2b$ hashes, httpOnly+Secure cookies, CORS with credentials and explicit origins, lockout (429) after 5 failed logins, foreign Origin POST rejected with 403. All requested flows work: RBAC (kasir/admin 403s, cost fields stripped), several Masuk jobs saved at the same time, package stock deducted exactly once even with 3 concurrent complete calls, kasir can add lines but not edit/remove them, discount pending -> blocks completion -> owner approves, DP + pelunasan with idempotency and overpayment rejection, owner cancel with partial refund and kept DP, direct sale idempotency and 409 on insufficient stock, one shared stock across job/sale/order, prepaid Bali order (COD rejected, stock deducted only when fully paid, ship blocked until paid), COD to Jawa Timur/Tengah (stock deducted on ship, cod_pending, settlement), returns (layak adds stock, rusak creates a damaged record, original kept, order set to Kembali), warranty claims (NG-, replacement at price 0 deducts stock, repair-only claim changes nothing, claim_seq 2, linked on original job and in vehicle history), stock correction/opname, CMS draft/preview/publish/revisions/restore, media upload. 2 backend defects found (overpayment after discount; javascript: allowed in navigation.cta_href). 2 report calculation defects found by checking API data against the code. Frontend: public pages at 1920 and 390 widths, admin login, Kasir sale -> receipt modal, job new -> add package with option -> Tandai Selesai, order form (COD shown only for Java provinces), CMS edit hero -> Simpan draft -> Pratinjau (/?preview=1 with banner) -> Terbitkan (visitors only see it after publishing), WA float button uses the published number, a visible service appears on /layanan, reordered sections show on the homepage, print 80mm/A4, Reports page with CSV download, kasir route guards. All passed.

critical.issue: A COD order that was shipped and then returned (ship_status Kembali, paid 0) still counts as recognized omzet. omzet_of() uses the full total and recognized stays True. Seen with WA-261108-003: total 1,520,000, paid 0, included in omzet.order. The returned goods' HPP is added back (return_hpp_back), so gross/net profit is inflated by revenue that was never received. Fix: when an order goes to Kembali or a return happens without a refund, reverse omzet (e.g. set recognized False, or subtract the returned value).

refund_total includes refunds from cancelled Masuk jobs/orders (DP refunds) that were never part of omzet, yet gross_profit = omzet - refund_total - ... subtracts them. Example: NB-261108-009 had DP 100k, refund 60k, kept 40k. Profit should rise by 40k, but it changed by -60k+40k = -20k. Fix: only subtract refunds linked to recognized transactions (returns), not cancel refunds.

minor.issue: A discount can be requested or approved after payments already cover the total, leaving paid > total (seen: total 80,000, paid 100,000) with no change/refund record. Reject the discount when the new total < paid, or create a refund/kembalian.

navigation.cta_href accepts 'javascript:alert(1)' because 'cta_href' is not in URL_KEYS (cms_routes.py:13). Add cta_href (and any other *_href / image keys) to URL_KEYS, or check every key ending in href/link/url.
The line lookup does not exclude removed lines, so a warranty claim can be opened on a line an admin removed.
These load the doc and then overwrite the whole lines array via save_totals. A concurrent POST /lines (kasir adding a line) can be lost. Use positional $set on lines.$[lid] or a version check.
If the plate already exists for a different customer, the existing vehicle is attached silently, so the job's customer differs from the vehicle owner. Warn the user or reassign explicitly.

ui_bugs.issue: A new Masuk job with no lines (total 0) shows 'Lunas' in the Pembayaran/DP card, and the 'Tandai Selesai' button is enabled even though the backend rejects completing with 400.
On a Selesai job with no discount, the Diskon card renders an empty body.

issues: Date range uses the browser's native date picker (input type=date, shows mm/dd/yyyy in English locale) instead of a shadcn Calendar/Popover with Indonesian format.
The native unstyled 'Choose Files' input looks out of place against the styled admin UI.
The 'Kirim via WhatsApp' <button> is nested inside an <a>, which is invalid interactive nesting. Style the <a> as a button instead.

Contact WhatsApp, address, services and catalog are empty in published CMS, so pages show placeholders ('Alamat belum diisi', 'Daftar layanan sedang disiapkan') and the header 'Chat WhatsApp' (#whatsapp) has no number. This is a content task, not code.

action_items: Reports: reverse omzet for COD/prepaid orders that were returned (Kembali) without payment. Currently phantom revenue inflates profit.
Reports: do not subtract cancel (DP) refunds of never-recognized jobs/orders from gross profit; only subtract refunds from returns on recognized transactions.
Discount: block a discount (request or approve) when the resulting total < amount already paid, or record a change/refund.
CMS sanitize: add 'cta_href' (and generic *href/*link/*url keys) to the URL_KEYS whitelist check so javascript: is rejected.
Claims: exclude removed lines when looking up line_lid.

Optional: positional updates for line edit/remove to avoid lost updates; disable 'Tandai Selesai' and hide 'Lunas' for jobs with total 0 and no lines; replace native date inputs in Reports with the shadcn calendar.
critical_code_review_comments: tx_routes.py is 747 lines (>700). Split into jobs/claims, payments/discount/returns, sales and orders modules.
report_routes.summary: gross_profit formula mixes cancel refunds with returns (see backend critical issues).
cms_routes.sanitize: URL validation is key-name based (URL_KEYS). Missing keys such as cta_href slip through. Consider validating any key matching /(href|link|url)$/.

core.add_payment returns None on a duplicate idem_key, and pay() pre-checks idem_key, so idempotency is good. cancel_job/process_return pass idem_key only for cancel refunds; return refunds use None, so a double-submitted return is protected only by the returns[].idem_key check.
complete_job and apply_order_stock use a lock flag plus stock_applied correctly; verified with 3 concurrent completes (deducted once).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested UI flows passed (minor UI/design notes only)

rca of the issue: 1) Phantom omzet: report_routes.recognized() takes every order with recognized=True. A /tx/order/{id}/return sets ship_status=Kembali but never clears recognized or adjusts omzet, so total-shipping is still counted. Repro: create a COD order, ship it, return it with refund 0, check summary.omzet.order. 2) Cancel refunds: summary.refund_total sums all payments with direction 'out', including add_payment(kind='refund') from cancel_job. gross_profit subtracts refund_total although the cancelled job was never in omzet. 3) Overpayment: request_discount/decide_discount only check amount <= subtotal, not new total >= paid.
